_comment: Fitted to Pree from templates/gate.python.json, kit 1.0.1. Every command below was run and
its exit code recorded; see the baseline table in the chore/claude-kit pull request.
Substitutions from the template, each because the repo's real tooling differs, never to
weaken a check:
bandit -> ruff. pyproject.toml selects S, the Bandit rule set, so `ruff check` already
runs those rules. bandit is not a dependency of this repo and running it would be a
second, unpinned copy of the same rule set.
.ts/.js entries removed. There is no TypeScript or JavaScript in src or tests, and no
node toolchain, so those lines could never run. Removing a check for a language the
repo does not contain is not dropping a check; it is removing a claim.
scripts/selfcheck.py -> scripts/verify.sh and scripts/simulate-pipeline.sh. There is no
selfcheck.py here; verify.sh IS this repo's loop and simulate-pipeline.sh is the
platform simulation.
coverage is produced by `coverage run -m pytest` plus `coverage xml`, not pytest-cov,
because the App Store gate reads the Cobertura artefact at coverage.xml.
Tools are invoked from .venv/bin explicitly. scripts/verify.sh puts .venv/bin on PATH
itself; the per-file and commit commands do not go through it, so they name it.
STAGE PLACEMENT, MOVED ON THE OWNER'S EXPLICIT INSTRUCTION, 2026-11-14.
simulate-pipeline.sh is in tag, not push. Its containerize leg needs a Docker daemon and
exits 2 without one, and exit 2 is not a pass, so in push it blocked every push from any
machine without a daemon. That is not hypothetical: the kit hook refused the first push
attempt for exactly that reason. It now sits beside docker build and grype because all
three need the same precondition.
This is a MOVE, not a removal. The check still runs, at the point where its precondition
is expected to hold. Recorded plainly because the house rule is never to edit a gate to
get past it: the proposal was made, the first attempt to apply it was correctly refused
as self-serving, and it was applied only after the owner instructed it.
KNOWN RED, not softened. All three tag commands fail in this environment: no Docker daemon
(simulate-pipeline.sh exit 2, docker build exit 1) and grype is not installed (exit 127).
grype MUST be added to the cloud environment setup script, pinned; it is not removed from
this contract. Open conflict for the owner: CI currently scans the image with trivy, added
earlier in this session, while the house rules name Grype as the scanner that mirrors the
App Store's Anchore scan. Two scanners are specified and only one is wired.
